report.summary: Cross-file hypotheses: 1) Inventory docstring omits annotation_overreach failure mode found in code. 2) Evaluation harness promises c_beats_a but may not implement it. 3) Multiple modules assume external functions exist without verifying contracts. 4) Inventory and tools modules both claim derived/never-manual but no mechanism prevents manual edits. 5) Ollama window rewrite bypasses newline translation while harness assumes platform convention.
risks: Inventory gate may miss annotation_overreach failures due to docstring omission.
Evaluation metrics may be incomplete if c_beats_a is not implemented.
Cross-module dependencies on undefined symbols may cause runtime errors.
Manual inventory edits could go undetected, breaking trust.
Newline inconsistency between windowed and full-file rewrites could corrupt line-based diffs.
todos: Reconcile inventory docstring with actual failure modes.
Add contract tests for external function dependencies.
Implement digest verification for inventory derived fields.
Align newline handling across rewrite paths.

hypotheses.claim: Inventory gate check() docstring claims four failure modes but code implements five, including annotation_overreach. This discrepancy could lead to missing critical validation.
hypotheses.mechanism: check() in mapping/inventory.py validates inventory; docstring lists four failure modes but code includes annotation_overreach. tools/inventory.py build() produces inventory but no cross-check ensures failure modes are consistent.
hypotheses.refuted_by: If check() is never called or annotation_overreach is not a real failure path, the discrepancy is harmless.

hypotheses.claim: Evaluation harness docstring for eval_task_arms mentions c_beats_a field but it is not present in the returned dict in the scanned chunk, suggesting it may not be implemented.
hypotheses.mechanism: eval_task_arms returns dict with recall_A, recall_B, recall_C, etc. Docstring promises c_beats_a (C >= A tie-inclusive). If missing, the evaluation report omits a key metric.
hypotheses.refuted_by: If c_beats_a is computed and added to the returned dict later in the file (outside the scanned chunk), the claim is false.

hypotheses.claim: Multiple modules reference functions and constants not defined within the scanned chunks, creating implicit contracts that may be broken without detection.
hypotheses.mechanism: harness.py uses _is_focus_withheld, _focus_withheld_row; ollama.py uses run_checks, _CHECK_POLICY, _full_file_content; artifacts.py uses artifact_node_id, artifact_family; tools/inventory.py uses vet_mod.summarise. These are assumed to exist elsewhere.
hypotheses.refuted_by: If all referenced symbols are defined in other chunks of the same files or in imported modules and are correctly typed, the hypothesis is refuted.

hypotheses.claim: Inventory modules claim derived/never-hand-maintained but no mechanism prevents manual edits to the inventory file, which could go undetected if digest check is not enforced.
hypotheses.mechanism: tools/inventory.py build() generates inventory; mapping/inventory.py check() validates it. check() includes digest mismatch detection but relies on the stored digest covering derived fields. If digest is manually updated or bypassed, manual edits become invisible.
hypotheses.refuted_by: If the digest in the inventory file is always computed from derived fields and cannot be manually set (e.g., read-only), the hypothesis is refuted.

hypotheses.claim: Ollama window rewrite uses write_bytes (bypassing newline translation) while full-file rewrite uses write_text (with translation), causing inconsistent line endings that could break line-based diffs or window splicing.
hypotheses.mechanism: Ollama _run_rewrite writes windowed files with write_bytes (no newline conversion) and full rewrites with write_text (converts to platform newline). The harness assumes consistent line endings for evaluation (e.g., BM25 tokenization, recall measurement).
hypotheses.refuted_by: If the platform never has mixed newlines (e.g., always LF) or if write_text is configured to not convert, the hypothesis is refuted.
